name: MG94
title: The Muse & Gaut (1994) model of dN/dS.

args.name: omega
args.description: Rate multiplier for nonsynonymous substitutions relative to synonymous substitutions

citation.title: A likelihood approach for comparing synonymous and nonsynonymous nucleotide substitution rates, with application to the chloroplast genome.

description:
The MG94 model describes codon frequencies in terms of four nucleotide frequencies. It is thus similar to GY94 with F1x4 frequencies. However, in MG94, rates from codon i to codon j depend on the frequency of the affected nucleotide, not on the frequencies of its neighbors. Each instantaneous substitution changes one nucleotide, and nonsynonymous rates are multiplied by omega.

The original MG94 model did not distinguish transition and transversion exchangeabilities. MG94K adds this distinction, and MG94_ext accepts an arbitrary nucleotide substitution model.

MG94 is equivalent to:

    F81 +> x3 +> dNdS
    MG94K(kappa=1)
    MG94_ext(F81)
